card.name: Words before 'indication' or 'use'
card.fires_on: Small determiners like any, this, these, or approved right before indication, use, or conditions, mostly in statements about approved or non-approved uses. Also fires on the blank spot before a section reference number in the highlights dosing lines.

modes.label: Approval wording
modes.description: A determiner such as any, this, or approved sits just before indication or use in a sentence about what a drug is or is not approved for.

modes.label: Before section numbers
modes.description: The gap right before a bracketed section number after a dosing line in the highlights.

card.writes: It pushes toward words like indication and indications, along with adapt-type words, and away from unrelated words.
card.plain: It marks the little word just before 'indication' or 'use' when a label says what a drug is or is not approved for.
